title: Beach Bliss Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Bliss is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionBEACH BLISSWaterColor Beach Community157 Scrub Oak Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights5 bedrooms (see room configurations in the “Room Details” tab)5 full baths, 1 half bathSleeps 8 adults & 4 children3,100 sq. ft. indoor space | 1,900 sq. ft. outdoor space with multiple porches and balconiesPrivate saltwater pool with lounge chairs (pool cannot be heated)Screened-in porch with outdoor dining, fireplace, and accordion doors opening to the living roomFirst-floor wet bar with wine refrigerator and sinkPropane grillAccess to nature preserve from the backyardFirst-floor laundry with full-sized washer and dryerDriveway for 2–3 vehiclesSix 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; additional rentals available upon request)Property DescriptionWelcome to Beach Bliss, a chic beach retreat where contemporary design meets Southern charm. The home features a classic wood and tin-roofed exterior, with sleek interiors showcasing lacquered white furniture, modern art, and stainless steel and glass accents.Comfortably sleeping 8 adults and 4 children, the home includes four bedrooms plus a bunk room, all with private baths. Second-floor bedrooms open to balconies, and the master suite offers a private covered porch overlooking the Western Lake Nature Preserve and the private saltwater pool.The main living area is perfect for gathering. Accordion-style glass doors seamlessly connect the kitchen to the screened-in porch, complete with a fireplace, sectional sofa, and dining area. Step outside to enjoy the pool and grilling area for ultimate relaxation and entertainment.Important Notes:Max occupancy: 8 adults and 4 children. No weddings or parties.WaterColor requires wristbands for guests 5+ years old; max 12 bands per home. Please provide accurate guest counts at least 2 weeks before arrival.Golf cart rentals are limited and must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. One per home, first-come, first-served.Community AmenitiesWaterColor Beach is known for eco-friendly design and exceptional amenities:Multiple community pools & playgroundsCamp WaterColor & WaterColor Beach ClubPrivate community beach accessWaterColor Town Center with shopping and diningWestern Lake, South Walton’s largest coastal dune lakeNature trails, parks, and pedestrian pathsWellness amenities including spa, boathouse, and tennis courts (fees may apply)ParkingThe home offers designated parking for up to three guest vehicles in the driveway. Please note that vehicle registration is required by the HOA prior to arrival.Golf carts must park on-propertyBooking & PoliciesNo smokingPets not allowed (service animals with documentation only)Published rates exclude taxes and fees50% due at booking, balance 60 days prior (or full if within 60 days)Cancelation: Initial 50% fully refundable if canceled >60 days before arrival; 5% cancelation fee applies otherwiseOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 10:00 AMGuests must be at least 25 years old
